enclosure.lid_screw_clearance_note: User print test 2026-10-25: M3 screws did not slide through the 3.4 lid holes; opened to 3.6.
enclosure.insert_seat_note: User print test 2026-10-25: the insert tip (D3.75) did not sit in the D3.9 pilot before heating. A D4.05 x 1.0 seat below the lead-in lets it stand upright; the D3.9 bore below keeps the melt grip.
enclosure.landing_basis: Landings match the carrier STEP mount-pad bodies (solids 5155-5158 D6.9 board holes, 5159-5162 D7.14 cooler holes) for full annular-ring contact; nearest underside part is >= 4.14 mm from any hole centre (bbox), so the landing edge clears it by >= 0.5 mm. Pads assumed identical on both sides; measure.
enclosure.heatsink_screw: M3 x 35 flat head, DIN 7991 / ISO 10642 (M3 from the module holes: D3.5 PCB, D3.7 thermal plate); threads up into the female standoffs between the AGX module and the heatsink

service_buttons.basis: SW1/SW2 are Alps SKQJLBA010 right-angle tact switches (schematic sheet 21), STEP product SWITCH4-8X7X7MM at PCB X137.4-148.4 and X147.0-158.0 (open shells 143/147). Actuator faces X141.16-144.66 / X150.79-154.29, Z3.83-7.33, tip at PCB Y160.89. User 2026-10-25: REC is the one closest to the USB/IO headers, RST the one closest to the far board edge. An earlier revision placed the holes at X16.6/22.9 over parts matched by size only; that was wrong.

antenna_bulkheads.connector: RP-SMA female bulkhead pigtail (1/4-36 UNS thread), inserted from inside, lock washer + nut outside
antenna_bulkheads.flat_note: RP-SMA bulkhead threads (1/4-36 UNS) carry one milled flat, 5.8 mm across (Wurth WR-CXASY 65530206515305: panel cutout D6.5 with the flat 6.0 across, panel 2.8 mm max). The hole's flat stops the body turning while the nut is tightened. On top it prints as a 3.8 mm bridge in place of a teardrop. Confirm across_flat with the P20 coupon.

enclosure.heatsink_thread_engagement_note: About 6 threads at the M3 0.5 mm pitch into the bottom of the cooler's 6.8 mm F-F standoff, whose thread starts on the copper spreader (module top + 0.5 mm pad + 2 mm spreader). That leaves 3.8 mm of the standoff for the short screws from the heatsink ears. Rev 0.8 counted from the module top (the 34 mm cooler); in a Rev 0.8 base the same M3 x 35 reaches only about 1.5 mm.
enclosure.heatsink_seat_note: Head seat raised inside the column (D7 pocket from the floor, 90-degree countersink at the top) so a standard M3 x 35 gives 3 mm (6 threads) in the G48R cooler's standoffs, leaving 3.8 mm of the 6.8 mm standoff for the short screws (heatsink_thread_engagement).
enclosure.lid_column_note: Each lid-screw column is fused to its side wall by a full-height buttress (wall face to column centre) with 4 mm concave fillets, plus a 3 mm radius fillet where it meets the floor (base) or roof (lid).
enclosure.support_fillet_note: Board posts and cooler columns: 3 mm concave radius fillet at the floor and 2 mm concave radius fillet between the pad landing and the broad column. Both stay below the landing top and are re-cut by the component relief.

floor_vents.note: Rev 0.8: hexagonal openings where the floor topology study (tools/topology.py floor: robot mounting, 10 g down + 5 g sideways) says the floor carries no load. They save filament and let cool air in under the board. 10 mm across flats keeps fingers out.

roof_ribs.note: Rev 0.9: eight ribs under the roof from the fan skirt to the middle of each wall and to the four lid-screw corners (the radial pattern of the Rev 0.8 roof topology study), centred on the fan, with a round boss where each meets the skirt. Roof 3.5 mm and ribs 8 mm deep from tools/lid_sweep.py (exports/structure/lid-sweep-0.9.json).

enclosure.roof_note: Rev 0.8: 4.5 mm roof with ribs (Rev 0.7: 6 mm, no ribs).

fan_grille.note: Rev 0.9: the roof is cut away over the fan down to a flush 3 mm grille (hub disc, 2 rings, 12 spokes); the fan top sits 2.44 mm under it. A skirt wall around the fan frame (6 mm clear, so a 3 mm fan-position error still clears; down to 3.5 mm below the fan top) is meant to keep the fan's exhaust (it blows up) going out through the grille (the 6 mm gap between frame and skirt stays open below, so some exhaust can spill back: see the cooled CFD) and stiffens the cut-out; the roof ribs start on it. Spokes, hub and thickness from the lid sweep (300 N): 12 spokes and a D20 hub flex least.

cooler.model: Seeed reComputer mini J501 heatsink with fan (SKU 100099421): a G48R heat-pipe tower (Li Yang Peng) on a 2 mm copper spreader, 9215 fan 92 x 92 x 15 mm, 12 V
cooler.datasheets: S05 references/100099421.pdf (110 x 100 x 50 mm, 12 V, 14.1-55.26 CFM); S06 references/reComputer_Mini_J501_Fan.pdf (G48R drawings: heatsink 93 x 102 x 33.3 mm, 97 x 102 x 48.3 mm with the fan, 5 x D6 heat pipes; fan 9215-Y)
cooler.identity_note: User photos 2026-10-27 (IMG_1852-1854) and the user: this cooler is fitted. The Rev 0.8 lid, sized for the 34 mm WS-RDN-601, hit it by about 15 mm.
cooler.center_note: Fan and fin centre, on the module centre. From IMG_1852 (corrected orientation: front I/O on the photo's right, DC IN at the top) with a two-plane fit (wall tops Z72, board screw heads Z24): fan hub at PCB (90.4, 90.5); the four mounting ears land within 2.6 mm of the four module holes. The lid tolerates +/-3 mm; measure the fan centre from the PCB edges to confirm.
cooler.size_note: Envelope from the spreader underside to the fan top: x along the heat pipes with their U-bends (102), y across the fins (fan 92, fins 93, 97 overall), z = 2 mm copper spreader + 48.3 mm heatsink with fan (S06).
cooler.tim_note: Thermal pad between the AGX thermal plate and the copper spreader (Seeed supplies pads); 0.5 mm nominal, measure the fitted pad. It raises the spreader and so the standoff thread start: a 1 mm pad leaves the M3 x 35 tie-down 2.5 mm of thread instead of 3 mm.

spreader.note: 2 mm copper between the AGX thermal plate and the heatsink (user). 100 x 110 from S05 (110 x 100 overall) and the photo (PCB y 25-138, x 38-137).

aux_fins.note: Black finned bar on the spreader rear edge (photo, S05 gallery). Height assumed.

standoffs.thread: M3 female; effective thread depth not measured
standoffs.note: Between the spreader and the heatsink bracket, short M3 screws each end (user). Pattern from the photo ears.
standoffs.axes_status: Ears placed on the module mounting axes (corrected photo fit, IMG_1852: within 2.6 mm of each hole). The M3 x 35 and the raised seat are chosen from this stack with an assumed 0.5 mm pad; check by hand that the screw turns 6 full threads into each standoff before fitting the short screws.

heatsink.material: Al 6063-T5 fins, C1100 copper base and heat pipes, nickel plated (S06)
heatsink.note: Plates stand across x (stacked along x, 84 mm), 93 mm wide in y: air from the fan leaves at the front and rear (+/-y) faces and under the fins. Pitch counted from IMG_1853 (about 48 plates); thickness assumed.

fan.note: Octagonal PBT frame 92.2 x 91.2 mm; corner chamfer legs read from IMG_1852.

ws_rdn_601.model: Seeed heatsink with fan for reServer J501 (p-5970, WS-RDN-601), 100 x 87 x 34 mm, 8015 5 V fan
ws_rdn_601.cover: The Rev 0.8 cover (release rev0.8, height 92) was sized for this cooler: intake ring 2 mm above its 34 mm top.

cooler.model: Seeed heatsink with fan for Jetson AGX Orin, WS-RDN-601
cooler.basis: Datasheet: 100 x 87 x 34 mm, copper heat pipes through stacked aluminium fins ('air-conditioner outdoor unit' construction), 8015 fan under a top grille, rated 100-120 W; the underside photo shows 3 flattened heat pipes and closed side plates. Assumed: fins 0.3 mm at 1.8 mm pitch, 3.5 mm base, air leaving through the two faces at +/-X (fin edges), effective base conductivity 1500 W/mK. Measure: fin count and thickness, which faces show fin edges, total height.
cooler.block_effectiveness_note: Starting point for the fin-temperature calibration only: a coarse J501 run delivered about 8.6 W at 43.5 C fins with 33 C intake air, i.e. the CFD fin block works at roughly a quarter of the uniform-flow conductance, because air from the fan turns straight out along the upper channels.

fan.note: 8015 PWM fan, 5 V, 2300 RPM: 22.90 CFM free air, 1.55 mmH2O at zero flow (datasheet; its two row labels are swapped). Straight-line curve between the two; blowing down into the fins (assumed); hub diameter from the drawing (about 33 mm).

alternatives.fans: Any 92 mm fan clips onto the G48R. A 92 x 25 mm fan sits 10 mm higher: lift the cover with tools/lid_riser.py --rise 10 and M3 screws 10 mm longer.

measured.note: Design keeps 70.0 mm (fan top Z91.56), 2 mm above the measurement, so the real grille gap is about 4.4 mm.

cooler.fan_xy_note: The fan is centred on the module (PCB 90, 90.5): the photo fit (IMG_1852, corrected orientation) puts the hub at (90.4, 90.5) and the four heatsink ears within 2.6 mm of the four module mounting holes, where the long M3 screws pass. The lid still keeps clear of the frame moved 3 mm in any direction, and of a 95 mm frame (S06 table size, may include the wire clips) moved 3 mm.

photo_registration.method: Two plane homographies (base wall top Z72; board screw heads Z24) and the straight camera ray between them. The first fit had the photo rotated 180 degrees (the front I/O, DC IN, RJ45 and audio, is on the right-hand wall of IMG_1852 with DC IN at the top) and put the fan 20 mm toward the front; corrected 2026-10-27. Results: fan hub PCB (90.4, 90.5) at the fan top; ears (138.1, 131.0), (137.5, 50.8), (44.3, 132.6), (42.9, 49.5) against module holes (136|44, 130|51); spreader 100 x 111 mm centred (90.6, 79.8); spreader finned bar x 51-130, y 27-46.
photo_registration.note: Photographs are kept locally, not redistributed.

source_notes: S06 contains generic G48R hardware, not a dimensioned Seeed copper adapter. Its 75/78 mm generic mount pattern must not replace the J501 registered 92 x 79 mm module pattern.
The 6.8 mm spacers support cooler mounting lugs. They are not added underneath the entire 48.3 mm cooler, which would introduce an unsupported air gap at the thermal contact.

Spreader plan, fan XY, lug XY, fin pitch, blades and heat-pipe paths are estimates. Pipe count/diameter, fin assembly height, fan frame/rotor dimensions come from S06; spreader thickness and spacer size are user measurements.
S06 fan table gives 95 x 95 x 15 mm while the frame drawing gives 91.2 x 92.2 mm. Use 95 mm for clearance checks.
Free-air and shutoff endpoints are not an operating-point or cooling-performance result. Existing WS-RDN-601 CFD remains about that older geometry.

audio.label: AUDIO

mate.basis: CON1/CON2 (MJ2135 library body) nose D6.0 at x 35.652 / 44.652, axis z 4.578, nose face y -2.0. Measured by slicing references/hardware/carrier-full.stl (+ open shells) at the mating face, 2026-10-25; pins and pegs below the PCB excluded. Plug overmold D8 assumed (slim plugs 5.5-6, common up to 8; the 9 mm jack pitch caps it).

audio.basis: One obround over both jacks, centred on the jack axes; sized for two D8 plug overmolds + 0.5.

gmsl.label: GMSL
gmsl.basis: Two candidate FM4 mini-FAKRA mouths; XY provisional (unchanged from Rev 0.4)

lan_1g.label: 1GbE

mate.basis: J5 LINK-PP LPJG16459BENL shield face and plug opening (latch up). Measured by slicing references/hardware/carrier-full.stl (+ open shells) at the mating face, 2026-10-25; pins and pegs below the PCB excluded.

lan_1g.basis: Centred on the J5 face; clears the RJ45 plug body and latch lever on insertion + 0.5; face LEDs visible.

lan_10g.label: 10GbE

mate.basis: J12 LINK-PP LPJK9436BENL shield face and plug opening (latch up). Measured by slicing references/hardware/carrier-full.stl (+ open shells) at the mating face, 2026-10-25; pins and pegs below the PCB excluded.

lan_10g.basis: Centred on the J12 face; clears the RJ45 plug body and latch lever on insertion + 0.5.

led.basis: LED4 light pipes x 128.437..131.382, z 2.703..10.653 at y -1.5 (+0.5); bridged to neighbours when the web is < min_panel_web. Measured by slicing references/hardware/carrier-full.stl (+ open shells) at the mating face, 2026-10-25; pins and pegs below the PCB excluded.

dc_in.label: DC IN 12-36V
dc_in.polarity_basis: J2 pin 1 = DCJ_IN (12-36 V, through F1), pin 2 = GND (carrier schematic sheet 7). Pins at x 141.91 / 146.99 are identical in the STEP; pin 1 is taken as the pin next to the F1 fuse holder (x 147). INFERRED, verify with a meter before first power-up.

plugs.basis: Phoenix Contact MSTB 2,5/2-STF-5,08 (1777989) dimensional drawing: 20.17 W x 15 H, 18.2 long incl. 8.3 tongue

mate.basis: J2 YL032-100-002 2-pin 5.08 mm horizontal header with screw flanges (GF style); flange screw holes at x 136.83 / 152.07 (15.24 apart, matches the STF plug), z 5.328; face y -2.7. Measured by slicing references/hardware/carrier-full.stl (+ open shells) at the mating face, 2026-10-25; pins and pegs below the PCB excluded.

dc_in.basis: Sized and centred on the mated screw-flange plug, which is 15 mm tall on an 8.4 mm header and passes through the plate (body 9.9 mm outside the header face). Wire the plug before inserting it: its clamp screws face up.

io_terminal.label: I/O

mate.basis: J25 + J2_TB1 2x10 3.81 mm push-in plug, modelled mated in the carrier STEP (its face shows the wire entries). Measured by slicing references/hardware/carrier-full.stl (+ open shells) at the mating face, 2026-10-25; pins and pegs below the PCB excluded.

io_terminal.basis: Centred on the mated J25 plug face + 0.5.

hdmi.label: HDMI

mate.basis: J8 Foxconn QJ3119C vertical HDMI face; typical HDMI overmold 21 x 11 rotated (assumed). Measured by slicing references/hardware/carrier-full.stl (+ open shells) at the mating face, 2026-10-25; pins and pegs below the PCB excluded.

hdmi.basis: Centred on the J8 mouth; 11 x 21 rotated overmold + 0.25.

mate.basis: J7 Foxconn UAA111C stacked USB-A, port centres z 5.55 / 14.65; typical 16 x 8 overmolds (assumed). Measured by slicing references/hardware/carrier-full.stl (+ open shells) at the mating face, 2026-10-25; pins and pegs below the PCB excluded.
J26 STEP is an incomplete 3.8 mm placeholder; footprint says 13.85 mm. Corrected envelope, centre assumed; 8 x 16 rotated overmold.

usb_a_vertical.basis: J26 corrected envelope; 8 x 16 rotated overmold + 0.25. Verify on hardware.

usb_c.label: USB-C

mate.basis: J9 (117.26,-1.58) and J10 (130.25,-1.11) underside USB-C mouths; typical 12.5 x 7.5 overmolds (assumed). Measured by slicing references/hardware/carrier-full.stl (+ open shells) at the mating face, 2026-10-25; pins and pegs below the PCB excluded.

usb_c.basis: Two USB-C overmolds + 0.25, side by side.

plug_envelopes_note: Every external port window is derived from its mated plug (cadagent.connectors via cad/ports.py), never from a receptacle bounding box: bounding boxes include pins below the board and miss plugs larger than the receptacle. tools/check_ports.py sweeps each plug in along its axis against the printed parts.

underside_envelopes.frame: PCB datum [x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1]; z below the PCB underside is negative

items.name: mini_pcie_card
items.basis: ST-PC-002 right-angle Mini PCIe on the underside (solid 4851, X1.53-31.43 Y67.65-76.74). Full-size 30 x 50.95 card runs toward +Y; latch/standoff bodies 5165/5166 at Y117.4-123. Depth allows a 4G/LoRa card stacked over the M.2 card plus U.FL plugs.

items.name: m2_b_card
items.basis: M.2 Key B (solid 4849, X5.49-27.39 Y56.91-65.61) under the Mini PCIe card; 3042/3052 per silkscreen, card toward +Y to Y113.

items.name: m2_e_card
items.basis: M.2 Key E (X48.93-58.68 Y21.75-48.27); 2230 card toward -X to the standoff body 4820 at X23.9 Y35; U.FL plugs included.

items.name: sata_plugs
items.basis: Two vertical SATA 7-pin receptacles on the underside (5063/5064; datasheet photo). Cable plugs mate from below; the zone drops through the floor so cables go straight down into storage modules.

items.name: sata_power_plugs
items.basis: JST PH 2.0 4-pin vertical headers (5061/5062): pin 1 NC, pins 2-3 GND, pin 4 SATA_5V (schematic sheet 27; Q59-switched VDD_5V_SYS, 2 A bead per port). No 12 V: VDD_12V feeds only the expansion connector (sheet 3).

d25.name: 2.5 in HDD/SSD up to 15 mm (SFF-8201)
d25.screw: M3 x 4 ISO 7380 button head (1.65 mm head fits the 2.2 mm counterbore)
d25.bottom_holes_note: SFF-8201: bottom holes are optional on drives 7 mm or thinner; use P19 side clips for those.

storage.basis: Drive dimensions from SFF-8301 Rev 1.9 Table 3-1 and SFF-8201 Rev 3.4 (references/storage). Board SATA power is 5 V only, so 3.5 in drives need 12 V from the module DC jack.
storage.interface_note: Standoffs hang from the part above: the male end passes up through that part's bottom ledge into its standoff (or the base insert); the hex bears on the ledge in a 2 mm counterbore and the female end rests on this tray's ledge. Every standoff is turned while fully exposed; build the stack upside down on the lid.

ssd_clip.floor_screw: M3 x 6 ISO 7380 button head + M3 hex nut (captive in the clip)
ssd_clip.side_screw: M3 x 5 ISO 7380 button head (2.0 mm max penetration for 7 mm drives)
ssd_clip.basis: Four clips per drive that has only side holes (SFF-8201 A52/A53 14.0 / 90.6 from the connector, A23 3.0 above the bottom). The clip foot sits over the tray bottom-hole pattern, so no extra tray holes.

cables.basis: No published SATA bend-radius standard was found (3M sells foldable SATA cable; the general rule is >= 15x cable thickness). Design values are conservative assumptions; prefer slim round SATA cables or foldable flat ones, never creased.
cables.wiring_rule: Wire a 3.5 in drive from the front SATA connector and a 2.5 in drive from the rear one; rear-to-3.5 in only allows a ~9 mm bend. Schematic ports: J21/J22 = port 0, J24/J23 = port 1; which physical connector is which is not in the STEP (check the SATA1/SATA2 silkscreen).

storage.connector_x_note: Drive connector ends sit this far from the left outer face so leads leaving the chimney keep their minimum bend radius before the straight lead into the drive plug.

thermal.note: Inputs to tools/thermal.py (cadagent.cfd + cadagent.heatsink). Datasheet values are cited; 'assumed' values are engineering guesses to replace with measurements.

limits.basis: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin datasheet DS-10662-001 (TTP 80 C max) and Jetson Linux r36.4 thermal page (99 C SW throttle, 105 C HW shutdown); Bambu Lab TDS heat deflection at 0.45 MPa (PLA Basic 57 C, PETG Basic 69 C). Wall limits are a design margin below HDT, our choice.

module.basis: AGX Orin 32 GB: 15/30/40 W modes (datasheet). Module envelope 100 x 87 x 16 mm from the NVIDIA STEP. Thermal plate thickness, SoC footprint and position under the plate, and the pad conductivity are assumed.

cooler.model: G48R heat-pipe tower (reComputer mini J501 heatsink)
cooler.basis: S06: fins 84 (stack) x 93 x 28.3 mm above a 5 mm gap, 5 x D6 copper heat pipes, 9215 fan on top blowing up (exhaust through the lid grille; air enters the fin block from its open sides; user, 2026-10-27). Base 7 mm = 2 mm copper spreader + 5 mm heatsink base. Assumed: fin thickness 0.35 mm, effective base conductivity 1500 W/mK.
cooler.block_effectiveness_note: Starting point for the fin-temperature calibration only: a coarse J501 run delivered about 8.6 W at 43.5 C fins with 33 C intake air, i.e. the CFD fin block works at roughly a quarter of the uniform-flow conductance, because air from the fan turns straight out along the upper channels.

fan.note: 9215-Y at full speed (12 V, 4000 rpm): 55.26 CFM free air, 2.87 mmH2O at zero flow (S06 p.2); straight-line curve between the two. Blows up: it pulls air in through the fin block's open sides and out through the lid grille (user, 2026-10-27, on the fitted cooler).

case.basis: Room air 25 C around the enclosure on a table (adiabatic floor 3 mm below the base: rubber feet), open (hydrostatic) on the other five sides, 30 mm beyond the walls and 40 mm above the roof.

criteria.note: Thermal plate at least 10 C under its 80 C limit at 40 W in 25 C air; fan at least 10 % of free air; air into the fins within 3 C of the room (no re-breathing of the fan's exhaust).

structure.note: Acceptance criteria for tools/structure.py results (tools/check_sim.py). Stress is the 99.9th percentile away from the supports, against PLA layer strength; deflection limits keep each revision at least as stiff as Rev 0.7. Rev 0.9: the roof keeps the Rev 0.7 deflection limit; the flush fan grille (the user accepts a weaker spot over the fan) only has to stay at least 1 mm clear of the fan under the same 300 N (fan gap 2.44 mm).
